chapters.title: The desk
chapters.say: Sixteen analysts. One trading desk. Real money on Solana. This is the fiftieth floor, and everything you're about to see is live.

beats.say: Sixteen analysts. One trading desk. Real money on Solana.
This is the fiftieth floor, and everything you're about to see is live.

chapters.title: The tower
chapters.say: Claude Tower. Fifty floors, one desk on each. The house desk works upstairs on fifty. It studies new coins all day, and publishes the few it would actually trade.

beats.say: Claude Tower. Fifty floors, one desk on each.
The house desk works upstairs on fifty. It studies new coins all day, and publishes the few it would actually trade.

chapters.title: Lease a floor
chapters.say: Any vacant floor can be yours. One floor per wallet. And right beside the price: the house bot's own record, with the house's own money.

beats.say: Any vacant floor can be yours. One floor per wallet.
And right beside the price: the house bot's own record, with the house's own money.

chapters.title: Step inside
chapters.say: Step inside. The house floor is open to everyone, no sign-in needed. Every character here is an analyst, and every one of them has a job.

beats.say: Step inside. The house floor is open to everyone, no sign-in needed.
Every character here is an analyst, and every one of them has a job.

chapters.title: The funnel
chapters.say: Watch the counter along the bottom. Coins studied today, coins turned down, and the few still on watch. Most of them die right here, and that is the point.

beats.say: Watch the counter along the bottom.
Coins studied today, coins turned down, and the few still on watch. Most of them die right here, and that is the point.

chapters.title: Big Callers
chapters.say: Big Callers is the raw feed — everything the desk has spotted. None of these is a call yet.

beats.say: Big Callers is the raw feed — everything the desk has spotted.

chapters.title: Candidates
chapters.say: Candidates are the shortlist, waiting to be studied.

beats.say: Candidates are the shortlist, waiting to be studied.

chapters.title: The calls
chapters.say: A published call carries three numbers. An entry, a stop, and a target. That is what your bot acts on — nothing vaguer than that.

beats.say: A published call carries three numbers.
An entry, a stop, and a target. That is what your bot acts on — nothing vaguer than that.

chapters.title: How it ended
chapters.say: Closed shows how each one ended, and the coins the desk turned down.

beats.say: Closed shows how each one ended, and the coins the desk turned down.

chapters.title: The money
chapters.say: The Overview is the money view. Profit and loss, straight out of the bot's own journal. Open positions draw as a bar: where it got in, the stop below, the target above.

beats.say: The Overview is the money view.
Profit and loss, straight out of the bot's own journal.

chapters.title: WALL-ST-E
chapters.say: Wall Street E is the bot itself. Your wallet, your caps, running on your own machine. The key is made there and never leaves it.

beats.say: Wall Street E is the bot itself.
Your wallet, your caps, running on your own machine. The key is made there and never leaves it.

chapters.title: HAWK-AI
chapters.say: Hawk A I is the second lane — a sniper that watches brand new launches.

beats.say: Hawk A I is the second lane — a sniper that watches brand new launches.

chapters.title: The receipts
chapters.say: Activity is the receipt. The tape, every decision the desk made, and the ledger underneath it.

beats.say: Activity is the receipt.
The tape, every decision the desk made, and the ledger underneath it.

chapters.title: Who is right
chapters.say: Performance ranks the analysts on one thing: whether they were actually right.

beats.say: Performance ranks the analysts on one thing: whether they were actually right.

chapters.title: Your track
chapters.say: Team is who works your floor. It is also where you choose who runs your bot — and you can run it yourself, with one command.

beats.say: Team is who works your floor.

chapters.title: Big C's board
chapters.say: And up on the wall, Big C keeps the live book. Every open trade, every close, redrawn every ten seconds.

chapters.say: Lease a floor. Plug in your own bot. Let it work.
